# Discuss

> Discuss is an ad-free social platform for developers to share technical discussions and projects, discover peers, join groups, and communicate privately.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://discussit.in/
- About: https://discussit.in/about
- Sign up: https://discussit.in/register
- Sign in: https://discussit.in/login
- Community guidelines: https://discussit.in/community-guidelines
- Privacy policy: https://discussit.in/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://discussit.in/terms

## Core capabilities

- Publish technical discussions, projects, links, images, and videos.
- Discover developers through DevRadar and TalentGraph.
- Join or create groups and use private real-time chat.
- Browse developer-focused technology news and jobs.

## Organization

Discuss was founded and developed by Mohammed Maaz A. Canonical site: https://discussit.in/
